channel.title: Parley
channel.description: Updates for Parley, WhatsApp as a real Mac app.

item.title: Version 0.1.5
item.description:
Layout fixes and a smoother sidebar.

Fixed

  • Long group names no longer cover the chat list. The name at the top of a conversation now stays inside the conversation and shortens to fit narrow windows.
  • Smoother sidebar. Showing or hiding the sidebar no longer stutters in busy chats.
  • Parley remembers the sidebar. If you hide it, it stays hidden the next time you open Parley.

Install

Parley 0.1.3 and later update automatically. Choose Parley › Check for Updates… to get it now.

New here or on 0.1.2 or earlier? Download Parley-0.1.5.dmg below and drag Parley to Applications. If macOS says it can't verify Parley, go to System Settings › Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway. The app isn't notarized yet.

Requirements: macOS 26 or later, Apple Silicon.

Parley is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.

item.title: Version 0.1.4
item.description:
A new emoji picker.

New

  • Built-in emoji picker. The 😊 button in the message field now opens an emoji popover with search, categories and your frequently used emoji. It closes when you click anywhere else, and you can pick several emoji in a row.
  • More reactions. The + in the reaction bar opens the full emoji picker, and picking an emoji reacts with it straight away.

Fixed

  • The emoji window no longer stays open after you click outside it.
  • Reacting with an emoji from + now actually sends the reaction.

Install

Parley 0.1.3 and later update automatically. Choose Parley › Check for Updates… to get it now.

New here or on 0.1.2 or earlier? Download Parley-0.1.4.dmg below and drag Parley to Applications. If macOS says it can't verify Parley, go to System Settings › Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway. The app isn't notarized yet.

Requirements: macOS 26 or later, Apple Silicon.

Parley is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.

item.title: Version 0.1.3
item.description:
Parley now keeps itself up to date.

New

  • Automatic updates. Parley checks for new versions once a day and offers to install them. Choose Parley › Check for Updates… (or the ••• menu in the menu bar panel) to check any time. Updates are signed, so Parley only installs versions published by its developer.
  • Update settings. Turn automatic checks, or fully automatic download and install, on or off in Settings › General › Updates.

Improved

  • The menu bar panel closes when you open something. Clicking Open, a chat, New Chat or Settings now brings up the window and dismisses the panel.

Install

  • Download Parley-0.1.3.dmg below and drag Parley to Applications, replacing the older version. This is the last manual update: from now on Parley updates itself.
  • Open it. If macOS says it can't verify Parley, go to System Settings › Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway. The app isn't notarized yet.
  • Already linked? You stay signed in.

Requirements: macOS 26 or later, Apple Silicon.

Parley is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.
